The Children of Exo have really disturbed this place ....|audio = TheNightmareRealmWave5.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 5 ([[The Nightmare Realm]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hex Revenant''' was a tanky enemy that appeared on Wave 5 of [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had a high amount of health and speed, stronger than the [[Hex Wraith]], while also having a decent amount defense. On some waves, it could spawn with the [[Bloated]], [[Nimble]] and [[Aggro]] attributes. ==Appearance== The '''Hex Revenant''' had a red skin and neon red eyes. On its torso, it had a large hole which revealed its ribcage, what appeared to be its heart and the lava that was inside its body. It wore a grey neckguard, grey shoulder-pads and grey padding around legs. On its shoulder-pads and padding, it had red crystals. On its arms, it had large grey claws. ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Militant]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be used to kill this quickly. *As this enemy has defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Cryomancer]] can be used to drop its defense. **Some of these can also be used to damage other enemies that spawn alongside it or slow it down, making it even easier to deal with. *On some waves, the '''Hex Revenant''' will spawn with [[Aggro]], making it force towers to target it. **Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful here. **The [[Trapper]] can be useful in such situations, as while it will still target it, its traps will damage any enemies that get past the [[Aggro]] '''Hex Revenant'''. Similarly, unit collisions can also be effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Hex Revenant''' in the game trailer. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Hex Revenant''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Hex Revenant's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex Revenant''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Hex Revenant's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex Revenant''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Hex Wraith]]|Wave 2|Hex Revenant|Wave 5|[[Forsaken Skull]]|Wave 6}} {{Containment|[[Hex Wraith]]|Wave 2|Hex Revenant|Wave 5|[[Hex Corpse]]|Wave 6}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
